name: THOMAS CHACRA
tagline: Environmental bioengineer, data, reporting and process improvement
addressee: To the Underwriting Services team, Zurich Insurance, Zaventem.
subject: Application: Traineeship Insurance Administrator (137418), Thomas Chacra
paragraphs: Most of my work so far has ended the same way: a process that somebody had been running by hand, turned into something that runs itself and can be checked afterwards. That is the part of the Underwriting Services traineeship I recognise, even though I have never worked in insurance.

I have built Excel and Power BI tools that took over recurring reporting, and I have worked with financial data closely enough to know that the numbers only matter if the trail behind them is clean. Coordinating that across teams is the part I enjoyed most. On one analysis, automation cut the processing time to about 30 % of what it had been, and the gain came from removing rework rather than from working faster.

I will be honest about the gap: I have no insurance background, no Dutch, and my degree is in environmental bioengineering rather than economics. The posting asks for Dutch or French plus English, so French and English I can offer at C1. What I would bring is a habit of picking apart an administrative process and then rebuilding it so it stops generating errors.
I would welcome the chance to discuss the rotations, and I am glad to hear your feedback either way.
